ranges._note: low / central / high are drawn only from sourced entries; 'basis' names the entry ids. A null means the evidence is missing. Different units or bases are not mixed.

pd_ag_h2_permeance_400_500C.unit: mol m-2 s-1 Pa-1 (single gas, permeate at atmospheric pressure; exponent not stated)
pd_ag_h2_permeance_400_500C.basis: low = P01 (a lower bound, measured, 450 degC, 4.61 um). No central or high measured value in the same units was found. A modelled alternative on a Sieverts basis is P10: 1.89e-3 mol m-2 s-1 Pa-0.5 at 450 degC (5.2 um, Richard fit). Flux cross-check P11 gives 0.60 to 0.74 mol m-2 s-1 at 5 bar feed / 1 bar permeate, so the two bases agree in magnitude.

ideal_h2_n2_selectivity.phase2_d2_correction: Cechetto's own printed permeances give 40,500 for the double-sealed membrane (P03, printed 3.7e-11), not 400,000 as stated in the same paragraph. The Phase 2 comparison (results/research/purification/phase2_comparison.json) uses low 40,500 (derived from printed values), central 400,000 (stated), high 500,000 (stated, dead end); 6000 (secondary excerpt) is a stress value only. Requirement for Grade D: 12,919 (R 0.90, 1 bar permeate, 400 degC); every sourced value is above it, the printed-value low by a factor of about 3.1, not 30.
ideal_h2_n2_selectivity.basis: low = P13 (greater than 6000, 2 um Pd, secondary excerpt); central = P05 (greater than 400,000, double sealed, 450 degC); high = P04 (greater than 500,000, dead-end). All are single-gas ideal values on NEW membranes; all are lower bounds ('greater than'). Mixed-gas selectivity and its change with time: not found as numbers in verified sources; the only time-dependence numbers (P15, 6000 to 4300 and 4300 to 1000 in about 1000 h) come from an unopened review table and are not used. Indirect mixed-gas evidence: purity 99.995 % (P07) and Ammogen minimum 99.98 % (P21).
ideal_h2_n2_selectivity.vs_phase1_requirement: The Phase 1 membrane case required at least 12,919 (300 ppm N2). Cechetto 2021 reports ideal selectivity above 400,000 at 450 degC on a new membrane, which exceeds it by a factor of about 30, but this is a new-membrane single-gas value from one group. Ageing, sealing leaks and the mixed-gas case are not covered, so the requirement is supported by one measured source, conditionally.

membrane_lifetime.basis: low = L01 lower end; central = L02 (also Richard 2024 in AmCraX Phase 1); high = L03 and the DOE target L04. These are assumptions or targets. Measured: about 600 h (P06, lab, NH3), 2068 h on a system (P18, Ammogen, not per membrane), over 6000 h (P14, Pd in natural-gas reforming, secondary excerpt). No source gives a measured degradation rate or a replacement interval for a Pd-Ag membrane in cracked ammonia beyond about 2000 h.

membrane_cost_per_m2.unit: per m2 of membrane (currency as stated)

central.entry: M01 (model value, midpoint of the 5000-15000 literature range)

membrane_cost_per_m2.basis: No source gives a supplier quotation with year. The values are literature or model values; the Phase 1 value of 6000 EUR/m2 (M05) sits just below the low end. A currency conversion to USD or SGD is not applied here (no exchange rate in this file); the analysis uses the single sourced rate from the reference scenario. Projections 1000-5000 USD/m2 (M02) and a patent target below 500 USD/m2 (M06) are targets, not prices.

psa_recovery_at_99_9_percent_purity.basis: low = S02 (derived interpolation of Yanez 2020; ammonia-plant purge gas feed, not cracked ammonia). No source gives a recovery at 99.9 % for cracked ammonia. Neighbouring points: 71 % at 99 % (S04), 75.3 % at 99.25 % (S01), 75.6 % at 99.11 % (S03).

psa_recovery_at_grade_d_purity.unit: % of H2 in feed (Grade D = 99.97 % H2 index)
psa_recovery_at_grade_d_purity.basis: low = S01 (99.97 %, purge-gas feed); high = S06 (99.96 %, modelled, internally inconsistent paper, LOW confidence). Central: none. The Phase 1 assumption of 0.85 recovery and the Phase 1 bounds 0.71 and 0.751 are not supported by a source at Grade D purity. NH3 must be removed upstream to 0.1 ppm; no source gives a measured NH3 value after a PSA/TSA train on cracked ammonia.

psa_specific_power.basis: Evidence missing (see S08). Candidates exist but are inconsistent or unverified.
